hero.title:
Discover Egypt
Where Every Wave Tells A Story
hero.description: From the turquoise coral lagoons of Hurghada to the golden temples of Luxor and the Nile Valley — SeeDora curates bespoke private VIP journeys crafted with perfection.
hero.searchPlaceholder: Search VIP tours, diving, Nile cruises, pyramids...

destinations.title: Egypt's Most Extraordinary Destinations
destinations.description: Four iconic regions, each with a unique soul — from Red Sea paradise to Nile Valley wonders.

hurghada.description: Egypt's Red Sea jewel — pristine beaches, world-class diving, vibrant nightlife and desert adventures await.

cairo.description: The Great Pyramids, Sphinx, Egyptian Museum — the cradle of civilization awaits your discovery.

luxor.description: Karnak Temple, Valley of the Kings, Nile cruises — the world's greatest open-air museum.

sharm.description: Ras Mohamed National Park, world-famous reefs, luxury resorts — the ultimate Red Sea retreat.

trips.title: Our Most Popular Tours
trips.description: From day trips to multi-week adventures — every SeeDora tour is crafted with passion, safety and luxury in mind.

snorkeling.name: Snorkeling Safari – Orange Bay
snorkeling.description: Sail to the stunning Orange Bay Island, snorkel among vibrant coral reefs, enjoy a BBQ lunch on a pristine beach.

cairo.name: Pyramids & Cairo Explorer
cairo.description: Visit the Great Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx, Egyptian Museum with Tutankhamun's treasures and Khan El Khalili bazaar.

luxor.name: Luxor – Valley of Kings & Karnak
luxor.description: Explore the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, Karnak and Luxor Temples — Egypt's most magnificent ancient sites.

quad.name: Quad Bike & Bedouin Village
quad.description: Ride quad bikes through golden dunes, visit a traditional Bedouin village, enjoy camel riding and a stunning sunset.

nile.name: Luxury Nile Cruise – Luxor to Aswan
nile.description: Sail the legendary Nile on a 5-star cruise ship, visiting Edfu, Kom Ombo, Aswan Dam and the magnificent Abu Simbel temples.

diving.name: Scuba Diving – Ras Mohamed
diving.description: Dive in one of the world's top 10 dive sites with PADI certified instructors. Beginners and advanced divers welcome.

sinai.name: Mount Sinai Sunrise & St Catherine
sinai.description: Climb Mount Sinai by night, witness a breathtaking sunrise, visit the ancient monastery of St. Catherine — a spiritual journey.

submarine.name: Glass-Bottom Boat & Submarine
submarine.description: Experience the magical underwater world without getting wet — perfect for families. Observe exotic fish and corals in crystal clear water.

atv.name: Desert Safari & Stargazing Dinner
atv.description: Sunset 4x4 desert safari, traditional Bedouin dinner under a billion stars, with live music and belly dance show.

why.title: The SeeDora Difference
why.description: 15 years of crafting extraordinary Egyptian experiences for European travellers with safety, luxury and authenticity.

languages.title: 5 Languages
languages.text: Our multilingual guides speak English, German, Italian, French and Russian — you'll always feel at home.

safety.title: 100% Safe Travel
safety.text: Licensed and insured, with Egypt Tourism Authority approval. Your safety is our absolute priority on every trip.

luxury.title: Luxury Standards
luxury.text: Premium transport, 4 & 5-star hotels, gourmet experiences — because you deserve nothing but the best.

price.title: Best Price Guarantee
price.text: We match or beat any comparable offer. Transparent pricing — no hidden fees, no surprises. Just exceptional value.

klaus.text: SeeDora gave us the holiday of a lifetime. The Pyramids trip was perfectly organized, our guide spoke excellent German and took care of everything. Absolutely magical!

marco.text: The Nile Cruise was beyond expectations. Waking up every morning to see ancient temples from the boat deck — simply unforgettable. Thank you SeeDora!

natalia.text: The desert safari was incredible — quad bikes, camels, Bedouin dinner under the stars. Our Russian-speaking guide made us feel totally at ease. 10/10!
